display_long_description:
Discover the universe of space weather with Aura Space Weather Data Explorer. This innovative app brings you real-time data from NASA and NOAA, allowing you to explore solar events in a true 3D environment. Whether you're a space enthusiast, researcher, or just curious about the cosmos, Aura offers an unparalleled experience for visualizing and interacting with solar phenomena. 
With intuitive controls and stunning visuals, immerse yourself in the dynamic world of space weather and gain insights like never before. Step into the future of space weather with Aura Space Data Explorer. 

Key Features:

- See the latest Solar Imagery from both the GOES Solar Ultraviolet Imager (SUVI) and the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO)
- Track the magnitude of geomatic storms using the Planetary K Index available from NOAA’s Space Weather Prediction Center
- Track solar flares using the X-ray flux data  available from NOAA’s Space Weather Prediction Center
- Monitor high-energy particles and their potential impacts on satellites and space-based assets using proton flux data  from NOAA’s Space Weather Prediction Center
- Monitor the intensity of the outer electron radiation belt using Electron Flux data from NOAA’s Space Weather Prediction Center
- Refresh and fetch new data from space with just a single tap

Download the free app now to explore real-time solar events and space weather.
